key_facts: Criminals are using AI to make scams more convincing, including fake retailer websites that claim to be family-owned UK firms but often deliver nothing or cheap mass-produced goods, according to trading standards officers.

Recommended protection includes never sending money, gift cards or personal/financial information to someone not met in person, checking shop addresses and FCA Firm Checker, verifying job adverts directly with the business, and treating pressure or urgency as a warning sign.
